choice.basis: The dashboard's plotted line, which is the primary evidence source, shows a net increase in respiratory infection cases from approximately 1,000 in 2012 to a peak of 3,000 in 2022, ending at approximately 2,850 in 2023. This represents a significant overall upward trend across the decade. Although the chart title reads 'Falling Respiratory Infection Cases' and the final year shows a slight dip, the dominant visual pattern of the data series is an increase. The 'increasing-activity follow-up' route best fits this overall increasing case pattern.
choice.option_label: Route the record to increasing-activity follow-up
